source.title: The Wrath of the Dawn
source.description:
Regardless of the reason that beast withdrew back to the enclave, we will not give it another chance to destroy us. It seems that our hand is forced and we must now commit the full fury of the Argent Dawn to the cause of ending the threat of the Scarlet Enclave.

Go back to the Scarlet Base Camp and meet back up with Beatrix. Let her know that she has our support... for now.
source.objective: Report back to Commander Beatrix at the Scarlet Base Camp in Eastern Plaguelands and make ready to retake the Scarlet Enclave.
source.progress: I saw smoke rising from the direction of Light's Hope, what has happened?
source.completion:
Some sort of beast attacked Light's Hope? That is bold of Balnazzar. Too bold, as now the Argent Dawn has committed to our cause. I won't lie to you and tell you I am not relieved to receive their assistance. I don't think we can take the enclave with the forces at our command now.

We're in the endgame now, <class>. Prepare your forces.
